name: todo-tree
description: Finds TODO, FIXME and NOTE comments across your project and lists them in the sidebar.

commands.title: TODO Tree: Scan the Whole Project

views.title: TODO Tree
views.description: Comment tags found in the project, grouped by file

settings.title: Tags
settings.description: Comma separated words to look for.

settings.title: File types
settings.description: Comma separated extensions to scan, without the dot.

settings.title: Maximum files
settings.description: Stops after this many files. GitHub repositories are limited to 40 to avoid hundreds of requests.

settings.title: Update when saving
settings.description: Re-scan a file every time it is saved.
